svg.title: How Rossi comic source plugins run
svg.desc: An MD3 Expressive plugin pipeline: three source pills on the left, a wine-red cookie-shaped Rust sandbox in the middle, and three arched Flutter UI cards on the right, joined by thick rounded connectors and shape badges.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

g.text: One JS file = one comic source
